task_instance: For a fictional small SaaS company (Nimbus Analytics, Inc.) preparing for a first SOC 2 Type II audit, produced: (1) a control inventory (CSV) mapping 13 controls to SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria with owners, evidence locations, and status; (2) a gap analysis (Markdown) comparing current state to requirements with a prioritized remediation plan and timeline; (3) an audit prep checklist (Markdown) organized by control domain; (4) a compliance status dashboard (Markdown) summarizing readiness %, priority items, and an audit calendar. All deliverables are plain text/CSV/Markdown files, matching the skill's stated Output section (compliance status dashboards, gap analyses, audit prep checklists, evidence collection plans).
evidence: Created input-notes.md (sample user-supplied facts about the company's current compliance posture), control-inventory.csv (13 rows covering CC1.1-CC9.1 and A1.1-A1.3 with owner/evidence/status columns), gap-analysis.md (status summary table: 3 implemented/4 partial/6 gap, three priority tiers, 8-week remediation timeline), audit-prep-checklist.md (8 sections of actionable checkboxes tied back to control IDs), and compliance-dashboard.md (readiness metrics, category breakdown, this week's focus, audit calendar, evidence health). All files written under the work directory /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec_gr/anthropics__knowledge-work-plugins__compliance-tracking@office-assistant/. Verified each file by reading it back after creation (e.g. re-read compliance-dashboard.md, confirmed content and formatting rendered correctly). No code execution, binaries, or connector/MCP tools were needed since the entire deliverable is text/CSV/Markdown, which is within the office-assistant runtime's granted abilities.
